<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoomService" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RoomServiceManager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveOrderToSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignOrderToWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverToRoom</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrderPending</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeferBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderDebited</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Msg_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start kitchen, sommelier and cart preparation"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare other alcoholic beverages" >
      <bpmn:documentation>Performed for the roughly 80% of room-service orders that include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Food, wine and cart ready"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeliverToRoom" name="Deliver food, wine and cart to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" name="Another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_NoOtherOrder"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeferBilling" name="Defer billing"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing due"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderDebited" name="Guest account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicket" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_FetchWine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverToRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_DeferBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAnotherOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOtherOrder" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_DeferBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="End_OrderDebited"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
